name: hide-payload-in-images
description: A project that demonstrates embedding shellcode payloads into image files (like PNGs) using Python and extracting them using C/C++. Payloads can be retrieved directly from the file on disk or from the image stored in a binary's resources section (.rsrc)

name: Trojan-through-Process-Hollowing
description: Trojan using process hollowing, shellcode encrypted 3 times, undetected by Windows defender

name: AV-evasion-payloads
description: This is an evaluation of  simple payloads to run shellcode while evading anti-virus solutions. Primarily focused around Win Defender.  The focus is to see how effective each of these techniques remain in the current landscapee
